title: Just Closed | 5508 Encino Oak Way, Killeen, TX
description:
✨ Just Sold! ✨

Dear Michael, congratulations on the purchase of your beautiful new home! I’m so excited to have been a part of this new chapter as you move to Texas. Welcome home! I pray you’ll find peace and all that God has planned for you here. Remember, I’m always here if you need anything. 

Nicole Pias-James, thank you once again for being an amazing partner throughout this process. I’m so grateful for you. ❤️🤗

Big hugs,
Gloria M. Miller
